instruction: Pull the audio out of this music video as an OGG file and drop it on the desktop named "track.ogg".

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: 'Desktop/track.ogg', format: 'file_magic', offset: 0, length: 4, default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
